pairing_note: The counted statement is the author's Theorem environment at source lines 307-308 (label 3.1), placing the Dedekind-finite tree set U_T into the definable cardinality class Delta_5 and giving the sharper negative clause when the tree has infinitely many ramification orders; the proof environment at source lines 310-347 immediately follows it and is its own proof. The proof takes a surjection with finite support, shows that every point outside the definable closure of the support is fixed by a two-case analysis, and contradicts surjectivity against the finiteness of that closure; all of it is inside the counted span. The counted spans contain no reference to any labelled item and no bibliography citation, so the card carries no navigation stub and no bibliography excerpt.
